name: Ghost of Christmas Past
source:
A Krampus worker agent is sent to the living world to accompany lost souls on the brink of being irredeemable.

[Edited from [url=https://lilyghost67.itch.io/ghost-of-christmas-past]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名為坎卜斯工作的使者被派往生者的世界，陪伴那些徘徊在無可救贖邊緣的迷途靈魂。

［編譯自[url=https://lilyghost67.itch.io/ghost-of-christmas-past]itch.io[/url]］
